import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
d=pd.read_csv('/tmp/out_test/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0); o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=img.copy(); bad=0
for (i,r),(_,ro) in zip(d.iterrows(),o.iterrows()):
    xs=list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))); ys=list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))
    pts=np.array(list(zip(xs,ys)),np.int32); m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[pts],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m); bad+= n!=2
    assert len(set(zip(xs,ys)))>4
    assert (min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys))==(r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)
    cnt+=m; cv2.polylines(vis,[pts],True,(0,255,0),1)
    cv2.rectangle(vis,(ro.xmin,ro.ymin),(ro.xmax,ro.ymax),(0,0,255) if ro.type=='rectangle' else (255,0,0),1)
print('overlap px',(cnt>1).sum(),'noncontig',bad, 'rows',len(d), (d.columns==o.columns).all())
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
"
